tier_should.rationale: Clean theoretical contribution on x-risk and growth; clear comparative statics under hazard elasticity. Results are credible, general, and policy-relevant. Limited external validation and narrow focus likely cap it at solid field journals rather than top general.

tier_will.rationale: Topic and framing are niche for mainstream economics; absent empirics or calibration, placement likely in low- to mid-tier field journals. Without senior coauthors or strong ties, probability of top field outlet is modest.
